One package per framework since 2.0, each with `/player`, `/bar`, `/playlist` and `/sounds` sub-paths. The sixteen single-component packages they replace are on [Framework wrappers (1.x)](/changelog/frameworks-1x/).

## `@arraypress/waveform-react`

### 2.1.0 — 2026-11-21

For the 2.1 cores (`@arraypress/waveform-player`, `-playlist` and `-sounds`
2.1.0; `-bar` stays 2.0).

#### Fixed — sounds (`./sounds`)
- **`loop={false}` rendered the Loop toggle pressed on the server**, then
  flipped it on hydration: the server `renderSounds` call didn't pass
  `loop`. The render options now come from the core's
  `pickRenderOptions()` (`@arraypress/waveform-sounds/render`) instead of a
  hand-kept list, so a render option the core adds reaches the server
  markup without an edit here.

#### Changed
- **sounds**: a re-mount whose markup didn't change hands the next instance
  clean rows with the core's `destroy({ restore: true })` instead of
  rewriting the host's `innerHTML`.
- **playlist**: imports `@arraypress/waveform-playlist/no-autoinit`. The
  2.1 root scans the page for `[data-waveform-playlist]` and registers
  `<waveform-playlist>` on import, which a component that builds its own
  playlist must not trigger.
- **Peers**: `@arraypress/waveform-playlist` and `@arraypress/waveform-sounds`
  are `^2.1.0` (the APIs above are 2.1). `-player` and `-bar` stay
  `^2.0.0`. All four remain optional.
- The sound list's handle `instance.engine` is now typed as the core's
  `WaveformPlayer | null` (was `unknown`), from the sounds core's types.

### 2.0.0 — 2026-11-21

The four React wrappers in one package, one sub-path per component, built
for the 2.0 cores and React 19.3+:

| Sub-path | Replaces |
| --- | --- |
| `@arraypress/waveform-react/player` | `@arraypress/waveform-player-react` 0.9.0 |
| `@arraypress/waveform-react/bar` | `@arraypress/waveform-bar-react` 0.5.0 |
| `@arraypress/waveform-react/playlist` | `@arraypress/waveform-playlist-react` 0.5.0 |
| `@arraypress/waveform-react/sounds` | `@arraypress/waveform-sounds-react` 0.2.1 |

Each sub-path exports the same names, props, refs and types as the package
it replaces, plus the additions below. Moving over means changing the import
path, installing the 2.0 cores and being on React 19.3+.

#### Requirements
- **React 19.3+ only** (`react` peer `^19.3.0`; React 18 is no longer
  supported).
- **The 2.0 cores**: every core peer is `^2.0.0` — `@arraypress/waveform-player`,
  `-bar`, `-playlist` and `-sounds`. They stay optional peers: install only
  the cores of the components you use.
- **Node 22.12+** (`engines`), as the cores.
- **Browsers**: the cores' 2.0 floor, Chrome/Edge 111, Firefox 114,
  Safari 16.4.

#### Added — player (`./player`)
- Props for the 2.0 player options, each forwarded to the core and
  re-creating the player when it changes:
  - `duration` — the track's length in seconds, known before the audio
    loads, so the total time, markers and seeks work with `preload: 'none'`
    before anything is fetched.
  - `lazy` — build the player now, load and draw it when it nears the
    viewport.
  - `loop`, `showLoop`, `loopLabel` — whole-track looping and its toggle
    button.
  - `showVolume`, `volume`, `volumeLabel`, `muteLabel` — mute toggle and
    volume slider, and the initial volume.
  - `showDownload`, `downloadUrl`, `downloadName`, `downloadLabel` — a
    download link for the track.

  `duration`, `downloadUrl` and `downloadName` are per-track: they follow
  `url` (a new `url` re-creates the player with the values given with it).
- Event props `onSeek`, `onRateChange`, `onVolumeChange` and `onLoop`, for
  the 2.0 core's `waveformplayer:seek` / `ratechange` / `volumechange` /
  `loop` events. Each receives the event's `detail` (`WaveformSeekEventDetail`
  and friends, exported from `./player` with `AudioCrossOrigin`). Like the
  other callbacks, a new handler never re-creates the player. They concern
  the player's own audio, so they don't fire with `audioMode: 'external'`.
- `waveform` accepts compact `wp1:` peaks (`"wp1:"` + base64url, about a
  quarter the size of a JSON array), as the 2.0 core does.
- JSX typing for the core's `<waveform-player>` custom element
  (`WaveformPlayerElementProps`): with the element registered (import
  `@arraypress/waveform-player`), `<waveform-player src="/a.mp3"
  duration={187} waveform-style="bars" />` typechecks.

#### Added — playlist (`./playlist`)
- Track `duration` is seconds or a clock string (`225`, `'3:45'`,
  `'1:02:03'`); playlist 2.0 also gives it to the player.
- Track `downloadUrl` / `downloadName`, rendered as `data-download-url` /
  `data-download-name`.
- Track `waveform` accepts `wp1:` peaks.
- Props `showVolume`, `volume`, `showDownload`, `volumeLabel`, `muteLabel`
  and `downloadLabel`, which the playlist passes to its player.

#### Added — bar (`./bar`)
- Trigger `duration` documented as seconds or a clock string, and
  `waveform` as accepting `wp1:` peaks: bar 2.0 passes both to the player.

#### Changed
- **ES modules only.** No CommonJS build (`.cjs`, `.d.cts`) and no
  `require` export conditions, like the 2.0 cores. `require()` still works
  on Node 22.12+, which loads ES modules through it.
- **Components are React 19 function components with a `ref` prop** instead
  of `forwardRef` wrappers. `ref={…}` works as before, with the same handle
  types (`ComponentRef<typeof WaveformPlayer>` is `WaveformPlayerHandle`).
- The playlist props no longer accept options the playlist drops (`loop`,
  `showLoop`, `loopLabel`, `lazy`, like `audioMode` before them) or the
  per-track `duration` / `downloadUrl` / `downloadName` (set those per track).
- The bar's types come from the bar itself (it generates them in 2.0); the
  local shim declaring the module is gone.
- Built with tsdown instead of tsup, with declarations from TypeScript 7.
- No root `.` entry: import a sub-path.

#### Removed
- Typing fallbacks for playlist cores before 1.8.0, and the named-export
  fallback used when loading a core (a CommonJS interop shape the ESM-only
  cores can't produce).

## `@arraypress/waveform-vue`

### 2.1.0 — 2026-11-21

For the 2.1 cores (`@arraypress/waveform-player`, `-playlist` and `-sounds`
2.1.0; `-bar` stays 2.0).

#### Fixed — sounds (`./sounds`)
- **`loop: false` rendered the Loop toggle pressed on the server**, then
  flipped it on hydration: the renderer's option list didn't include
  `loop`. The render options now come from the core's
  `pickRenderOptions()` (`@arraypress/waveform-sounds/render`) instead of a
  hand-kept list, so a render option the core adds reaches the server
  markup without an edit here. `loop` is still applied live with
  `setLoop()`: a change never re-patches the markup.

#### Changed
- **sounds**: a rebuild over unchanged markup hands the next instance clean
  rows with the core's `destroy({ restore: true })` instead of rewriting the
  host's `innerHTML`.
- **playlist**: imports `@arraypress/waveform-playlist/no-autoinit`. The
  2.1 root scans the page for `[data-waveform-playlist]` and registers
  `<waveform-playlist>` on import, which a component that builds its own
  playlist must not trigger.
- **Peers**: `@arraypress/waveform-playlist` and `@arraypress/waveform-sounds`
  are `^2.1.0` (the APIs above are 2.1). `-player` and `-bar` stay
  `^2.0.0`. All four remain optional.
- The exposed `instance.engine` is now typed as the core's
  `WaveformPlayer | null` (was `unknown`), from the sounds core's types.

### 2.0.0 — 2026-11-21

One package replaces the four Vue wrappers, and it is built for the 2.0
cores (`@arraypress/waveform-player`, `-bar`, `-playlist` and `-sounds`
2.0).

| Before | Now |
| --- | --- |
| `@arraypress/waveform-player-vue` (0.7.0) | `@arraypress/waveform-vue/player` |
| `@arraypress/waveform-bar-vue` (0.4.0) | `@arraypress/waveform-vue/bar` |
| `@arraypress/waveform-playlist-vue` (0.5.0) | `@arraypress/waveform-vue/playlist` |
| `@arraypress/waveform-sounds-vue` (0.2.1) | `@arraypress/waveform-vue/sounds` |

Each sub-path exports the same components, props, emits, exposed API and
types as the package it replaces, plus the 2.0 additions below. Switching is
a change of import path. There is no root import: each sub-path loads only
its own core with `import()`, so you install only the cores you use.

#### Requirements

- **The 2.0 cores.** Every core is an optional peer at `^2.0.0` (was
  `^1.27.0` for the player, `^1.11.0` bar, `^1.8.0` playlist,
  `^0.2.0 || ^0.3.0` sounds). 2.0 cores run on Chrome/Edge 111+, Firefox
  114+ and Safari 16.4+.
- **Vue 3.5+ only** (`vue` peer `^3.5.0`, as before).
- **Node 22.12+** (`engines`, was `>=18.0.0`), as for the cores.
- **ES modules only.** The CommonJS builds (`dist/<name>/index.cjs`,
  `index.d.cts`) and the `require` export conditions are gone, like the
  cores'. Node 22.12+ loads the ES modules through `require()`.
  `typesVersions` stays, so TypeScript's `moduleResolution: "node"`
  (`node10`, which ignores `exports`) still finds every sub-path's types.

#### Added — player (`./player`)

- **The 13 options new in the 2.0 core are props**, forwarded only when set
  (so the core's defaults apply otherwise) and remounting the player when
  they change: `duration` (seconds, shown as the total and used for seeks
  until the audio's metadata arrives), `lazy`, `loop`, `showLoop`,
  `loopLabel`, `showVolume`, `volume`, `volumeLabel`, `muteLabel`,
  `showDownload`, `downloadUrl`, `downloadName`, `downloadLabel`.
  `duration`, `downloadUrl` and `downloadName` are per-track: the component
  remounts on a `url` change, so each follows the url it is set with.
- **`@seek`, `@ratechange`, `@volumechange` and `@loop` emits**, each with
  the `detail` of the core's `waveformplayer:<name>` event
  (`WaveformSeekEventDetail`, `WaveformRateChangeEventDetail`,
  `WaveformVolumeChangeEventDetail`, `WaveformLoopEventDetail`, re-exported
  with `AudioCrossOrigin`). They come from the player's own `<audio>`, so
  they fire in self mode only.
- **`waveform` accepts compact `wp1:` peaks**, passed through for the core
  to decode.

#### Changed — player

- **Emits are typed.** The component declares its emits with their payload
  types (the six callback emits keep the core's arguments), so `@play`,
  `@timeupdate`, … listeners are typed in templates instead of `any`.

#### Added — playlist (`./playlist`)

- **The 2.0 player options the playlist passes to its player are props**:
  `showVolume`, `volume`, `showDownload`, `volumeLabel`, `muteLabel`,
  `downloadLabel`.
- **Track input**: `duration` is seconds or a clock string (`225` or
  `'3:45'`, was a string only); the 2.0 playlist shows it and hands it to the
  player as its `duration`. New `downloadUrl` / `downloadName`, rendered as
  `data-download-url` / `data-download-name`, set that track's download link.
  `waveform` accepts `wp1:` peaks.

#### Changed — playlist

- **Not props, because the 2.0 playlist never passes them to its player**:
  `loop`, `showLoop`, `lazy` (it strips them, like `audioMode`) and
  `loopLabel` (it only names the loop button). `duration`, `downloadUrl` and
  `downloadName` are per-track fields of `tracks`, not playlist props.
  `WaveformPlaylistProps` omits all of them.
- Layout props are typed straight from the playlist core; the fallback for
  pre-1.8.0 cores is gone.

#### Changed — bar (`./bar`)

- Config keys are unchanged. A trigger's `duration` is documented as seconds
  or a clock string (the 2.0 bar passes it to the player, so the length
  shows before any audio loads), and `waveform` as accepting `wp1:` peaks.
- The ambient `declare module '@arraypress/waveform-bar'` shim is gone: the
  2.0 bar ships its own types, including `Window.WaveformBar`. This package
  declares nothing global, so the two can't conflict.

#### Changed — sounds (`./sounds`)

- Built for `@arraypress/waveform-sounds` 2.0. Props, emits and the
  server-rendered markup are unchanged (the SSR output stays byte-identical
  to the core's `renderSounds`).

#### Removed

- The CommonJS builds and `require` conditions (see Requirements).
- Compatibility with 1.x cores: the playlist's fallback types and option
  list for pre-1.8.0 playlist cores, and the bar's "1.12.0+, older bars
  ignore it" caveats on `barRadius` and `showTime`.

## `@arraypress/waveform-svelte`

### 2.1.0 — 2026-11-21

For the 2.1 cores (`@arraypress/waveform-player`, `-playlist` and `-sounds`
2.1.0; `-bar` stays 2.0).

#### Fixed — sounds (`./sounds`)
- **`loop={false}` rendered the Loop toggle pressed on the server**, then
  flipped it on hydration: the server `renderSounds` call didn't pass
  `loop`. The render options now come from the core's
  `pickRenderOptions()` (`@arraypress/waveform-sounds/render`) over the
  forwarded options instead of a hand-kept list, so a render option the
  core adds reaches the server markup without an edit here.

#### Changed
- **sounds**: a rebuild over unchanged markup hands the next instance clean
  rows with the core's `destroy({ restore: true })` instead of rewriting the
  host's `innerHTML`. Switching from `manifest` to `sounds` now has the
  runtime build the list from `sounds` (the same `renderSounds` output)
  rather than adopt Svelte's render.
- **playlist**: imports `@arraypress/waveform-playlist/no-autoinit`. The
  2.1 root scans the page for `[data-waveform-playlist]` and registers
  `<waveform-playlist>` on import, which a component that builds its own
  playlist must not trigger.
- **Peers**: `@arraypress/waveform-playlist` and `@arraypress/waveform-sounds`
  are `^2.1.0` (the APIs above are 2.1). `-player` and `-bar` stay
  `^2.0.0`. All four remain optional.
- `bind:instance` / `getInstance()`'s `engine` is now typed as the core's
  `WaveformPlayer | null` (was `unknown`), from the sounds core's types.

### 2.0.0 — 2026-11-21

The four Svelte wrappers are now one package, `@arraypress/waveform-svelte`,
with one sub-path per component, built for the 2.0 cores.

#### One package, four sub-paths

Each sub-path exports what its old package did — the same components, props,
callbacks and instance methods. Only the import changes:

| Old package (last version) | New import |
| --- | --- |
| `@arraypress/waveform-player-svelte` (0.7.0) | `@arraypress/waveform-svelte/player` |
| `@arraypress/waveform-bar-svelte` (0.4.0) | `@arraypress/waveform-svelte/bar` |
| `@arraypress/waveform-playlist-svelte` (0.5.0) | `@arraypress/waveform-svelte/playlist` |
| `@arraypress/waveform-sounds-svelte` (0.2.1) | `@arraypress/waveform-svelte/sounds` |

There is no root import. The four cores are optional peer dependencies:
install the ones for the sub-paths you import (`./player` needs only
`@arraypress/waveform-player`; the others also need their own core).

#### Requirements

- **The 2.0 cores**: `@arraypress/waveform-player`, `-bar`, `-playlist` and
  `-sounds` `^2.0.0` (TypeScript with generated types, ES2022: Chrome/Edge
  111+, Firefox 114+, Safari 16.4+).
- **Svelte 5.59+ only** (peer `^5.59.0`, was `^5.20.0`). Only the latest
  Svelte is supported.
- **Node 22.12+** (`engines`), like the cores.
- ES modules only, as before (built with `@sveltejs/package`; there never
  was a CommonJS build).

#### Player (`./player`)

- **New props for the 2.0 core options**, each forwarded only when set:
  `duration` (seconds; the total time before the audio loads, so a
  `preload="none"` player shows its length with no audio request), `lazy`,
  `loop`, `showLoop`, `loopLabel`, `showVolume`, `volume`, `volumeLabel`,
  `muteLabel`, `showDownload`, `downloadUrl`, `downloadName` and
  `downloadLabel`. `duration`, `downloadUrl` and `downloadName` describe the
  track at `url`: a `url` change remounts the player with the new values
  (and without the old ones).
- **`waveform` accepts compact `wp1:` peaks** (`"wp1:"` + base64url, one byte
  per peak, as `@arraypress/waveform-gen` writes them) besides an array, a
  `.json` URL or a JSON string.
- **New event props** `onseek`, `onratechange`, `onvolumechange` and
  `onloop`, for the 2.0 core's `waveformplayer:seek` / `:ratechange` /
  `:volumechange` / `:loop` events. Each receives the event's detail
  (`WaveformSeekEventDetail`, `WaveformRateChangeEventDetail`,
  `WaveformVolumeChangeEventDetail`, `WaveformLoopEventDetail`, re-exported
  from `./player`). Self mode only, as in the core. Changing a handler never
  remounts the player.
- **Callback prop types replace the host `<div>`'s same-named DOM handler
  types** (`onplay`, `onload`, `onerror`, `onratechange`, …) instead of
  intersecting with them, so a handler's parameter is the player or the
  event detail.

#### Playlist (`./playlist`)

- **Tracks**: `duration` takes seconds (`225`) or a clock string (`'3:45'`,
  `'1:02:03'`) — rendered as `data-duration`, which the 2.0 playlist shows and
  passes to the player as its `duration`. New `downloadUrl` / `downloadName`
  (rendered as `data-download-url` / `data-download-name`) set that track's
  download link. `waveform` accepts `wp1:` peaks.
- **New props forwarded to the player**: `showVolume`, `volume`,
  `showDownload`, `volumeLabel`, `muteLabel`, `downloadLabel`.
- **Not props**: `loop`, `showLoop`, `loopLabel` and `lazy` (the playlist
  never passes them to its player: a looping track never ends, which stops
  `continuous`), and the per-track `duration`, `downloadUrl`, `downloadName`
  (set them on each track). Like `audioMode`, a stray one is swallowed —
  never forwarded, never on the host element.

#### Bar (`./bar`)

- A trigger's `duration` is documented as seconds or a clock string, which the
  2.0 bar passes to its player; `waveform` may be `wp1:` peaks. The config
  type's keys are unchanged.
- The component calls `init()` / `destroy()` on the singleton the bar module
  exports, instead of looking it up on `window.WaveformBar`.

#### Sounds (`./sounds`)

- No API change. Built against `@arraypress/waveform-sounds` 2.0, whose
  server-rendered markup is byte-identical to 0.3.

#### Removed

- Compatibility code for 1.x cores: the optional-method instance types and
  their `?.()` checks, the `default ?? named` constructor lookups, the bar's
  `window.WaveformBar` lookup, the playlist's fallback types for playlist
  cores before 1.8.0, and the ambient `@arraypress/waveform-bar` module shim
  (bar 2.0 ships its own types).

## `@arraypress/waveform-astro`

### 2.1.0 — 2026-11-21

For the 2.1 cores (`@arraypress/waveform-player`, `-playlist` and `-sounds`
2.1.0; `-bar` stays 2.0).

#### Fixed — sounds (`./sounds`)
- **`loop={false}` rendered the Loop toggle pressed**, until the runtime
  flipped it: the server `renderSounds` call didn't pass `loop`. The render
  options now come from the core's `pickRenderOptions()`
  (`@arraypress/waveform-sounds/render`) instead of a hand-kept list, so a
  render option the core adds reaches the server markup without an edit
  here.

#### Changed
- **Peers**: `@arraypress/waveform-sounds` is `^2.1.0` (`pickRenderOptions`
  is 2.1). `-player`, `-bar` and `-playlist` stay `^2.0.0`. All four remain
  optional.
- README: the 2.1 cores' `<waveform-playlist>` and `<waveform-sounds>`
  custom elements can be written directly in an Astro page.

### 2.0.0 — 2026-11-21

One package replaces the four 1.x-era Astro wrappers, and it is built for the
2.0 cores (`@arraypress/waveform-player`, `-bar`, `-playlist` and `-sounds`
2.0).

| Before | Now |
| --- | --- |
| `@arraypress/waveform-player-astro` (0.8.0) | `@arraypress/waveform-astro/player` |
| `@arraypress/waveform-bar-astro` (0.5.1) | `@arraypress/waveform-astro/bar` |
| `@arraypress/waveform-playlist-astro` (0.5.0) | `@arraypress/waveform-astro/playlist` |
| `@arraypress/waveform-sounds-astro` (0.2.1) | `@arraypress/waveform-astro/sounds` |

`<old>/WaveformX.astro` and `<old>/types` move to `.../<name>/WaveformX.astro` and
`.../<name>/types`. There is no root import: each sub-path loads only its own
core.

#### Requirements

- **The 2.0 cores.** Every core is an optional peer at `^2.0.0` (was
  `^1.24.5` for the player, `^1.11.0` bar, `^1.8.0` playlist,
  `^0.2.0 || ^0.3.0` sounds); install only the ones you use. 2.0 cores run
  on Chrome/Edge 111+, Firefox 114+ and Safari 16.4+.
- **Astro 7.4+ only; Astro 6 is no longer supported** (the peer range was
  `^6.0.0 || ^7.0.0`, now `^7.4.0`).
- **Node 22.12+** (`engines`), as for the cores.
- ES modules and TypeScript source only, as before: the package ships `src/`
  and has no CommonJS build or `typesVersions`.

#### Added — player (`./player`)

- **The 13 options new in the 2.0 core are props**, each emitted as its
  `data-*` attribute only when set: `duration` (seconds, shown as the total
  until the audio's metadata arrives), `lazy`, `loop`, `showLoop`,
  `loopLabel`, `showVolume`, `volume`, `volumeLabel`, `muteLabel`,
  `showDownload`, `downloadUrl`, `downloadName`, `downloadLabel`.
- **`waveform` accepts compact `wp1:` peaks**, passed through for the core to
  decode.
- **Events, documented and typed.** No callback props (a server-rendered
  component has nothing to call): the core's bubbling `waveformplayer:*` DOM
  events, including 2.0's `seek`, `ratechange`, `volumechange` and `loop`,
  are typed on `DocumentEventMap` by the core; their detail types
  (`WaveformSeekEventDetail`, …, `WaveformPlayerEventMap`) and
  `AudioCrossOrigin` are re-exported from `./player`.

#### Changed — player

- **`lazy` is the core's `lazy` option** (`data-lazy`). In 1.x it was the
  component's own: it rendered `data-waveform-player-lazy` and shipped an
  inline IntersectionObserver that built the player as it approached the
  viewport, polling up to ~1s for `window.WaveformPlayer`. Now the player is
  built at once (registered, its methods working, its title and loading
  state shown at full height, so nothing shifts) and the core defers the
  audio, the peaks and the drawing until it is within 200px of the viewport,
  with one shared observer. Pages using `<WaveformPlayer lazy>` keep working
  unchanged; only a stylesheet or script that targeted
  `[data-waveform-player-lazy]` needs to use `[data-lazy="true"]` instead.
- The `astro:page-load` re-init script now ships with every player (it used
  to skip lazy ones, which the removed observer mounted).

#### Added — playlist (`./playlist`)

- Container props `showVolume`, `volume`, `volumeLabel`, `muteLabel`,
  `showDownload`, `downloadLabel`, which the 2.0 playlist passes to its
  player.
- Per track: `duration` may be seconds (`225`) or a clock string (`'3:45'`;
  the 2.0 playlist shows it and passes it to the player), and
  `downloadUrl` / `downloadName` render as `data-download-url` /
  `data-download-name`. `waveform` accepts `wp1:` peaks.

#### Changed — playlist

- `loop`, `showLoop`, `loopLabel` and the player's `lazy`, which the 2.0
  playlist never passes to its player, and the per-track `duration`,
  `downloadUrl`, `downloadName`, are not container props. Neither are
  `onNextTrack` / `onPreviousTrack` (no callback props). The playlist's own
  `lazy` prop is unchanged: it defers building the whole playlist.
- The layout props take the playlist core's own types (the fallback for
  pre-1.8 cores is gone).

#### Changed — bar (`./bar`)

- A trigger's `duration` is documented as seconds or a clock string, and
  `waveform` as accepting `wp1:` peaks (waveform-bar 2.0 passes both to the
  player). Config keys are unchanged.
- `window.WaveformBar` and `window.WaveformPlayer` are typed by the cores'
  own declarations; this package no longer declares conflicting
  hand-written versions.

#### Sounds (`./sounds`)

- Unchanged; tested against waveform-sounds 2.0, and its server-rendered
  markup is still byte-identical to the core's `renderSounds`.

#### Removed

- The player's 1.x lazy-mount script (`data-waveform-player-lazy`,
  `window.__wfpLazyMountBound`, the wait-for-the-core retry loop).
- The swap teardown's check that `WaveformPlayer.getAllInstances` exists
  (every 2.0 core has it).
- The hand-written `window.WaveformPlayer` / `window.WaveformBar` shapes.
- The playlist types' fallbacks for cores older than 1.8.0.
